record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, derive fixed item counts c_i solely from training interactions and scale only history input embeddings by 1+0.02*(1-2*log(1+c_i)/log(1+c_max)). This bounded rarity feature may retain distinctive items while slightly attenuating ubiquitous context. Keep padding zero and candidate embeddings unchanged. Preserve learned embedding design, GRU topology, readout, scoring, loss and optimizer. Save category-specific scaling constants and reproduce them through the predictor writer; retain one model per category.
